title: CAD Trust Data Schema v2.0.2
source: CAD Trust Data Dictionary v2.0.2 (27 Jan)
description: Machine-readable schema for the CAD Trust v2.0.2 data model. Use to map registry fields to CAD Trust API fields, validate data before submission, drive automated ETL pipelines, or power an AI mapping agent. Always prefer live picklist values from GET /v2/governance/meta/pickList when a CADT node is available; the picklists in this file are a static, version-dated snapshot.

v2.0_key_changes: NEW TABLE: methodology — standalone methodology registry with versioning
NEW TABLE: project_methodology — junction table, supports multiple methodologies per project
NEW TABLE: label — credit eligibility labels (CORSIA, CCP, ITMO, SDG, etc.)
NEW TABLE: unit_label — junction table linking units to labels
NEW TABLE: stakeholder — named project participants (owner, developer, consultant, etc.)
NEW TABLE: program — programme/activity grouping with program_registry_id
NEW TABLES: aef_t1_submission, aef_t2_authorizations, aef_t3_actions, aef_t4_holdings, aef_t5_authorized_entities — Article 6 AEF reporting
RESTRUCTURED: validation split into separate validation and verification tables
NEW FIELDS on unit: unit_retirement_detail, unit_retirement_beneficiary, unit_retirement_beneficiary_id (LEI), unit_itmos_reference_id
NEW FIELD on location: location_map_type (GIS file format picklist), location_map_file_link
ISSUANCE now links to project_methodology via cad_trust_project_methodology_id

source_values.user_input: Registry supplies this field in the API request body.
source_values.system: Auto-generated or inferred by CADT. Do NOT include in API requests.
source_values.api_generated: Set by the API layer (e.g. createdAt, updatedAt). Do NOT include in API requests.

program.description: A crediting program under which projects are registered (e.g. Gold Standard, VCS). Projects reference a program via cadTrustProgramId.

cad_trust_program_id.description: Auto-generated on create. Used as FK by project records.

program_name.description: Full name of the crediting program.

program_registry.description: Name of the registry managing this program.

methodology.description: A carbon accounting methodology. Linked to projects via the project_methodology join table.

methodology_name.example: METHODOLOGY FOR METERED & MEASURED ENERGY COOKING DEVICES

stakeholder.description: New in v2.0. An organisation or individual with a defined role on a project. Has a direct FK to project rather than a separate join table.

label.description: New in v2.0. A certification label (e.g. CCB Standards, SD VISta, Article 6 endorsements/authorisations). Assigned to units via the unit_label join table.

project.description: The central entity in the v2.0 data model. All child records reference a project via cadTrustProjectId. Create project before any of its children.

cad_trust_project_id.description: Auto-generated on create. FK for all child records.

project_id.description: The registry's own ID for the project. Not a CADT UUID.

project_sector.description: One or more IPCC sectors. Submit as an array even for a single value.

project_type.description: One or more project type classifications. Submit as an array even for a single value.

project_methodology.description: Join table linking a project to a methodology.

cad_trust_project_methodology_id.description: Used as required FK by issuance.

validation.description: A third-party validation event for a project — confirms the project is designed correctly before it generates credits.

cad_trust_validation_id.description: Used as optional FK by verification.

verification.description: A verification event confirming that emission reductions or removals occurred as claimed.

cad_trust_verification_id.description: Used as required FK by issuance.

cad_trust_validation_id.description: Optional FK to the related validation record.

location.description: Geographic location of a project. A project can have multiple location records.

cad_trust_location_id.description: Used as required FK by issuance.

estimation.description: Projected emission reductions for a project over a defined period. Multiple records allowed per project.

rating.description: Independent assessment of additional project attributes (e.g. sustainable development co-benefits, project risk). Multiple ratings allowed per project.

rating_value.description: Rating score, stored as string to support alphanumeric ratings.

co_benefit.description: UN Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) co-benefit. One record per SDG. Multiple records allowed per project. Key Article 6 objective: foster increases in collective ambition while supporting sustainable development.

co_benefit_id.description: UN SDG value. API field name is 'cobenefit' (lowercase, no 'Id' suffix) — do not use 'coBenefitId'.

issuance.description: A credit issuance batch. Units are children of an issuance.

cad_trust_issuance_id.description: Used as FK by unit records.

cad_trust_verification_id.description: Required FK to verification. New in v2.0.

cad_trust_project_methodology_id.description: Required FK to project_methodology. New in v2.0.

cad_trust_location_id.description: Required FK to location. New in v2.0.

unit.description: An individual carbon credit unit or block. The leaf-level entity.

unit_count.description: Auto-inferred from the start/end block range.

unit_label.description: Join table assigning a label to a unit. Both label and unit must exist before creating this record. One unit can hold multiple labels.

aef_t1_submission.description: Root AEF record for a country's Article 6 submission to the UNFCCC. Only used if a BTR report has been generated and is retrievable from the registry.

aef_t2_authorizations.description: Article 6.2 Table 2 — authorizations granted by a Party for ITMOs.

aef_t2_authorizations_sector.description: Inferred. Distinct picklist from project_sector — includes 'Agriculture forestry and other land use (AFOLU)', which project_sector does not.

aef_t2_authorizations_activity_type.description: Inferred. Distinct picklist from project_type — includes 'Fossil fuel switch', which project_type does not.

aef_t5_authorized_entities.description: Article 6.2 Table 5 — authorized entities permitted to participate in cooperative approaches. Create before T2 (T2 references T5).

aef_t5_authorized_entities_incorporation.description: Distinct picklist from location_country — 'Australia' is absent from this list.

aef_t3_actions.description: Article 6.2 Table 3 — ITMO transfer and use actions. The most field-dense AEF table.

aef_t4_holdings.description: Article 6.2 Table 4 — ITMO holdings at end of reporting period. Structurally similar to T3 but represents stock held rather than transfer actions.

conditional_requirements.then: the referenced validation record must already exist
verification, project_methodology, and location records must already exist for the parent project

conditional_requirements.if: aef_t3_actions or aef_t4_holdings records are submitted
conditional_requirements.then: a corresponding aef_t2_authorizations record must exist (required FK)

common_enum_mistakes.note: 'Active' was renamed to 'Held' in v2.0. Sending 'Active' fails validation with no fallback.

common_enum_mistakes.correct: unit_status has 8 values: Issued, Held, Retired, Cancelled, Expired, Buffer, Inactive, Rejected
common_enum_mistakes.note: Defaulting unrecognised values to 'Held' will misclassify units that should be 'Buffer' or 'Inactive'.
The actual API field name is 'cobenefit' (lowercase, no 'Id' suffix). Sending 'coBenefitId' is silently ignored, not rejected.
None of the v1-style names exist in v2.0. Field names changed completely for location.
projectSector and projectType must be arrays even for a single value.
Both fields are constrained to a list of 58 named VVBs. Capitalisation and punctuation must match exactly.

migration_from_v1.summary: v1 to v2.0 migration guide for registries.

steps.title: methodology
steps.v1: project.methodology was a single free-text string.
steps.v2: Create a methodology record for each unique methodology. Link projects via the project_methodology join table.
example_sql: INSERT INTO methodology (methodology_code, methodology_name, methodology_version) VALUES ('VM0007', 'REDD+ Methodology', '1.6');

steps.title: validation + verification (split)
steps.v2: Create one validation record and one verification record, optionally linked via verification.cad_trust_validation_id.

steps.title: issuance — new required FKs
steps.v1: Issuance linked directly to a project.
steps.v2: Every issuance record now requires THREE FKs: cad_trust_verification_id, cad_trust_project_methodology_id, and cad_trust_location_id. Backfill by creating verification, project_methodology, and location records first, then update issuance records.

steps.title: unit_status enum values
steps.v2: 'Active' renamed to 'Held'. Also note the full v2.0 picklist has 8 values, not the 3-4 commonly assumed.

steps.title: unit labels (new concept)
steps.v2: If your registry tracks credit eligibility (CORSIA, CCP, ICVCM, etc.), create label records and link to units via unit_label.

steps.title: program (new structured table)
steps.v1: Programme name stored as a free-text string on project.
steps.v2: Migrate to a program record (with programRegistry, programRegistryId) and reference via cadTrustProgramId on the project.

steps.title: stakeholder (new structured table)
steps.v2: Create stakeholder records for any organisation or individual with a role on the project (Owner, Developer, Consultant) and link via the direct cadTrustProjectId FK.
